adaptation.initial_state_change: x1 is 2.0 instead of the source default 0.0
adaptation.state_quantization: round each outer RK4 update to the nearest 1e-6 lattice point
adaptation.objective_orientation: u minimizes the terminal absolute position gap (maximizes the source reward); v maximizes the gap
adaptation.information_pattern: finite causal response: u selects from the current state, then v observes u and responds before the next state is observed
adaptation.information_pattern_change: v has within-stage observation of u, which the upstream Markov-game environment does not provide
adaptation.interpretation: source-derived finite game; not a reproduction of the continuous-action RL result

numerics.propagation: 20-step RK4 with held actions; state rounded once per 0.2-second decision stage
